$description: DHCW Single Record Design System — Semantic colour tokens (Tier 2) — Dark mode. All values reference primitive tokens. Applied as the 'Dark' mode in the Single Record Figma variable collection. Status foreground tokens use lighter palette values to maintain contrast on dark surfaces.

primary.$description: DHCW brand secondary — vibrant and distinct on dark surfaces

primary-hover.$description: Lighter step for hover — dark mode hover moves lighter, not darker

secondary.$description: Muted blue for secondary interactive elements

link.$description: Soft cyan — readable as inline link text on dark backgrounds

destructive.$description: Unchanged — white text on red-600 meets AA (5.18:1). Non-text contrast is borderline; enforce a visible border at component level.

background.$description: Main page background in dark mode

small-cards.$description: Card and panel surfaces in dark mode

accent.$description: Deep blue for accent / highlighted areas

subtle.$description: Subtle section background — table rows, inactive tabs

section-cards.$description: Primary background for card sections in modular layout — dark mode

primary.$description: Primary text on dark — 13.8:1 on navy-900 (AAA)

inverse.$description: Text on light elements within a dark-mode interface

focus.$description: Unchanged — focus yellow is visible on both light and dark

critical.$description: Light red for critical text/icon — high contrast on dark surfaces

critical-surface.$description: Deep blue dark surface for critical banners — red-100 text differentiates

success.$description: Light green for success text/icon — high contrast on dark

success-surface.$description: Dark navy surface for success banners

info.$description: Info Blue 700 — matches light mode. Verify contrast against final surface colour at implementation.

info-surface.$description: Dark navy surface for informational banners
